Signals Separated in I-PDU ComSignal / Com- GroupSignal are not allowed to overlap each other.
Byte Aligned Array Signals ComSignal / Com- GroupSignal of ComSignalType UINT8_N and UINT8_DYN shall be byte aligned ( ComBitPosition is a multiple of 8).

Update Bit Excluded in case of Transmission Repe- titions For I-PDUs with transmission mode DIRECT or MIXED with ComTxModeNum- berOfRepetitions greater or equal 1 no update-bit ( ComUpdateBitPosition ) shall be configured.

Signal Group Gateway Configuration It shall not be allowed to configure signal groups for routing with data type differences between receive and transmit signal group. A sub-setting of signal groups (as defined in [SWS_Com_00735]) shall be supported.
Post Build Configuration Update The post-build time configuration part (post-compile and post-link time) can only be updated when it is not in use.

Float and Array Signal Filter Algorithm Limitations For signals with ComSignalType FLOAT32 , FLOAT64 , UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN , the AUTOSAR COM module shall only support ComFilterAlgorithm configured to ALWAYS , NEVER or ONE_EVERY_N .
Routed Signal Size Configuration The ComBit- Size of a received and to be routed ComSignal shall not differ.

Unique COM Model Element Names It is illegal for any two of the following parameters to have the same value: • shortName of a ComSignal • shortName of a ComSignalGroup • shortName of a ComGroupSignal 230 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 • shortName of a ComIPdu • shortName of a ComIPduGroup

Well-formedness of COM Model Element Names It is illegal for any of the following parameters not to be formulated according to C’s identifier rules: • shortName of a ComSignal • shortName of a ComSignalGroup • shortName of a ComGroupSignal • shortName of a ComIPdu • shortName of a ComIPduGroup • ComUserCallbackName

Boolean Signal Filter Algorithm Limitations For signals with ComSignalType configured to BOOLEAN , the AUTOSAR COM module shall only support ComFilterAlgorithm configured to: • ALWAYS • NEVER • MASKED_NEW_EQUALS_X • MASKED_NEW_DIFFERS_X • MASKED_NEW_DIFFERS_MASKED_OLD • ONE_EVERY_N
Mapping of Array Signals A ComSignal / Com- GroupSignal of type uint8[n] shall always be mapped to an n-bytes sized ComSignal / ComGroupSignal .

Transmission Mode Configuration Every ComTx- ModeTrue or ComTxModeFalse that is a potential result of the configured / calcu- lated TMS must be configured. Within the ComTxIPdu , at least one of the containers ComTxModeTrue or ComTxModeFalse has to be included.
Mandatory ComTxIPdu for TX I-PDUs A ComTx- IPdu container must be included if ComIPduDirection is configured to SEND .
ONE_EVERY_N Filter Configuration For the Com- FilterAlgorithm ONE_EVERY_N , the ComFilterOffset shall be configured to a value lesser than ComFilterPeriod .
OPAQUE Endianness of Array Signals A ComSig- nal / ComGroupSignal of type uint8[n] shall be configured to have OPAQUE endian- ness.

TP I-PDUs Excluded from Gateway A signal or sig- nal group contained in an I-PDU with ComIPduType configured as TP shall not be con- figured as source or destination within the ComGwMapping configuration container.

Callback Names Differ from COM Model Element Names It is illegal for any of the ComUserCallbackName parameters in all Co- mUserCallback containers to have the same value as any of the following five pa- rameters • Com_<shortName of a ComSignal > • Com_<shortName of a ComSignalGroup > • Com_<shortName of a ComGroupSignal > • Com_<shortName of a ComIPdu > • C…
Dynamic Length Signal Configuration A dynamic length I-PDU shall contain at most one dynamic length signal.
Placement of Dynamic Length Signals The dy- namic length signal shall be placed last in a dynamic length I-PDU.
Size Configuration of Dynamic Length Signals The ComSignalLength parameter shall be configured to the maximum size / length for dynamic length signals.

Transfer Property of Zero Length Signals The AU- TOSAR COM module shall not support the transfer properties TRIGGERED_ON_- CHANGE and TRIGGERED_ON_CHANGE_WITHOUT_REPETITION for signals and group signals with ComBitSize configured to 0.

Zero Length Signal Filter Algorithm Limitations For signals and group signals with ComBitSize configured to 0, the AUTOSAR COM module shall not support the filter algorithm MASKED_NEW_DIFFERS_MASKED_OLD .
Bit Size of Signals The ComBitSize of a (group) signal shall not extend past the size of its configured ComSignalType .

Interpretation of Signal Initial and Invalid Values The configured string of ComSignalInitValue / ComSignalDataInvalidValue shall be interpreted according to the definitions of [19] for the boolean and all numerical types.

Signal Invalid Value Configuration In case a Com- SignalDataInvalidValue is configured for a ComSignal that is included in a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection RECEIVE , the ComDataInvalidAction shall also be configured for this ComSignal .

Group Signal Invalid Value Configuration In case a ComSignalDataInvalidValue is configured for at least one ComGroupSignal of a ComSignalGroup that is included in a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection RECEIVE , the ComDataInvalidAction shall also be configured for this ComSignalGroup .
Direction of I-PDU Groups All I-PDUs that are con- tained within one I-PDU group shall have the same ComIPduDirection .
Meta Data Default Item Configuration The num- ber of ComMetaDataDefaultItem containers of a ComIPdu shall match the globally configured number of MetaDataItems of this I-PDU.
Signal User Configuration Sent signals or signal groups shall be owned by a single Software Cluster only and consequently either by Com users of RTE, or SwCluC, or one CDD.
